_source: v2: https://developer.paypal.com/limited-release/personal-payments-v2.md (integration guide; no public schema.json; /api/limited-release/personal-payments/v2/schema.json returns 404), read 2026-11-08
approval: You must be approved to use the Personal Payments v2 API. Request approval by email: p2papiapproval@paypal.com
do_not_use_when: Sender and receiver are the same entity (no deposits or withdrawals to the same user).

integration_patterns.PAYPAL_UI: Recommended for all partners except large enterprises. Create a personal payment token, redirect the user to PayPal's initiate_payment link with &return_url=..., PayPal authenticates the user and handles regulatory contingencies. Return URL receives status, transactionId, returnCode.
integration_patterns.PARTNER_UI: For large enterprises with an in-house compliance team. Extra authentication and explicit user consent; partner must keep UI compliant with government regulations (fines or shutdown if not).

fees.rule: Friends-and-family sends are free except card-funded; purchases carry a fee the payee always pays. fee.payer is PAYER or PAYEE; PURCHASE + PAYER is not allowed.

regulatory.remittance_transfer_rule: Transfers over $15 USD to a person or company in a foreign country. Funding-options response may carry regulatory_information.remittance_transfer_rule.action = DISPLAY_TRANSACTION_DISCLOSURES (review phase); fulfillment response carries disclosure_details (fees, estimated_funds_arrival, state_agency). The app must display all provided information.
regulatory.unilateral_rtr_error: TRANSACTION_DECLINED_ADDITIONAL_PAYEE_INFO_REQUIRED -> resend funding-options with payee.name and payee.country_code.
regulatory.travel_rule: US-based sender sending $3,000 USD or more; checked at fulfillment; funding options may include a travel_rule object.
